1. Compute the dark channel, the minimum over red, green and blue and over a square patch.
2. Pick the air light A among the brightest 0.1 percent of the dark channel.
3. Compute the raw transmission from the dark channel of the image divided by A.
4. Refine the transmission with the guided filter, guided by the luma.
5. Recover J from the haze model, with the transmission kept at t0 or more.
